title: Constraint Story
description: JSON authoring format for Deferential Realism constraint stories. Compiled to .pl by generate_constraint_pl.py.

AgentPower.description: Power atoms for classification contexts. Includes individual_moderate (corpus artifact from antifragility.pl).

DirectionalityPowerAtom.description: Strict 6-set for directionality overrides. Linter Rule 18 validates against this set.

GridMetric.description: Leveled coercion-grid metrics (OQ-93 migration, ruling (b) 2026-06-10). DELIBERATELY DISJOINT from MeasurementMetric: grid metrics are leveled (metric x level), scalar series are not — the redundancy diff witnessed zero overlap by disjoint input surfaces (audits/2026-06-10_oq93_grid_viability_probe/REDUNDANCY_DIFF.md); do not merge the enums. stakes_inflation is resurrected HERE ONLY (it greps to prompts/archives/ everywhere else).

time_point.description: Must equal the grid's t0 or tn — Draft/2020-12 cannot express the cross-field membership, so the COMPILER enforces it fail-loud (OQ-93 stage-2 battery item 1; --no-validate does not bypass).

MeasurementBasis.description: OQ-102(a) per-time-point provenance: 'observed' = the point reports something that has happened/been measured; 'projected' = an authored guess about a future or unmeasured state (the competition_timeline_pressure class — endpoints authored for a competition running to ~2030). OPTIONAL: absent = unspecified (back-compat with every pre-rider story); NEVER imputed or defaulted — an absent basis stays absent at every read site (the provenance bit travels with the value, or not at all). Compiler emits narrative_ontology:measurement_basis(MID, Basis) only when authored.

StakeholderRole.description: DECLARED dial-set (operator ruling, 2026-06-07; ISSUES.md OQ-83) — a seated, swappable framing chosen for fitness, NOT a complete topology read off the world. Stated bundlings: (1) backgrounds the time-index of role — today's agenda_setter is tomorrow's payer; roles are static in this schema, time-varying role/d is a deferred OQ (OQ-83). (2) backgrounds CONTENTION — contention is a RELATION between seats, derived by the engine from two same-power stakeholders with opposed roles (in_contention/3, engine layer); it is never authored as a role (operator ruling 2026-06-07: no contender role — authoring it would assert the conclusion the cross-framing falsifier measures). Empirical fit on the pre-migration corpus: 85.0% of 1,230 agent mentions align cleanly; systematic residue (contender 6.3%, ritual_operator 1.9%, dual_role ~1.3%, non_agent ~0.6%) is documented in audits/2026-06-07_stakeholder_layer_migration/a4_residue_ledger.md — that ledger is this declaration's attached Omega_C evidence and the revision key for the dial-set.
StakeholderRole.$comment: Role semantics: agenda_setter = sets, administers, or enforces the arrangement (five-questions Q1b: who sets the agenda — distinct from passively collecting); beneficiary = collects from the arrangement without running it; payer = bears its costs; excluded = would object but is not in the conversation (Q4) — commentary-grade only, NEVER correction-grade: an authored absence must not drive classification overrides (R3, OQ-83); observer = analytical seat, neither collecting nor paying.

Stakeholder.description: A named agent in the constraint story, described in plain situational language — no DR type vocabulary (mountain/rope/snare/...) anywhere in this object (R1, OQ-83: per-seat perception is COMPUTED by the engine from power/exit, never authored).

name.description: Domain-specific snake_case agent name (e.g. low_income_borrowers, not affected_parties). Names stay per-story and domain-specific; they are NEVER standardized across readings (OQ-84 guard asymmetry: same-kernel shared names enter inferred_coupling_protocol's edge set unfiltered). Stakeholder facts compile to a NEW predicate; beneficiary/victim derivation preserves per-story naming.

secondary_role.description: Optional second role for genuinely dual-positioned agents (A4 dual_role residue class, ~1.3%: e.g. a regulator that both coordinates and collects). Use sparingly; a stakeholder needing more than two roles is a sign the agent should be split.

agent.$comment: Agent-hood gate (A4 non_agent residue class; OQ-64 recurrence: doctrines, vocabularies, abstract goods appear in agent lists). false = the entry is a non-agent entity kept for narrative completeness — it is EXCLUDED from beneficiary/victim derivation and from directionality (mirrors the narrative_ontology non_agent registry principle: a non-agent must not feed d -> chi as if it collected from the constraint).

situation.description: The stakeholder's situation inside the constraint story, in plain language: what they do, what flows to or from them, what exit looks like from where they stand. Describe the situation; do not classify it.

Provenance.description: Generation provenance — REQUIRED on every story (Phase C growth rule, OQ-109 2026-06-12): the corpus is a sequence of cohorts and cross-cohort comparison is valid only when each story carries its generation conditions. An unprovenanced story is un-meta-analyzable by construction (fail-closed beats backfilling). schema_commit/prompt_commit = repo HEAD of the governing file at generation/validation time.

schema_commit.description: Commit of this schema the story validated against

source_essay.description: Source essay / topic-run identifier; 'none' for hand-authored

one_shot_example.description: Path of the one-shot example in effect (FNL inherited-signature machinery, per-cohort)

model.description: Generating model string (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6); 'none_hand_authored' for manual stories

sampling_params.description: Sampling parameters at generation (e.g. 'temperature=1.0'); 'none' for manual stories

seeded_from.description: Archived/prior story id this generation was seeded from; 'none' for unseeded. Identity is authored FORWARD here (kind-level only in the engine; never recovered backward by name/signature — CLAUDE.md determinism frontier).

draw.description: Replicate draw index for this seed (1-based; 0 = unseeded/hand-authored). Each draw is one sample from the generation distribution, never a re-measurement.

generation_run_id.description: SCOPE-manifest join key (OQ-254, 2026-07-25): the decomposition manifest's filename stem, minted at decompose time and pipeline-stamped (never model-claimed). Joins this story to the Q-choice that admitted it (axes selected/deferred, selection reasons, kernel verdict). 'none' = no manifest identity (pre-wiring stories, manifest-less generation paths) — the declared loud-null stratum, never backfilled. OPTIONAL, not required: pre-wiring stories stay valid.

constraint_id.description: Snake_case unique identifier for this constraint

version.description: Metadata version (recorded in header comment; does not change output structure)

measurement_id_prefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated measurement IDs (default: derived from constraint_id)

story_uid.description: UUIDv4 surrogate identity minted per generation event

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of generation event

accessibility_collapse.description: Required for ALL constraints (2026-06-09): how completely alternatives collapse once the constraint is understood. High for mountains/natural laws (~0.85+); lower for snares/ropes where alternatives persist. Author honestly; the engine decides certification. Absent values used to default to 0.5, fabricating verdicts.

resistance.description: Required for ALL constraints (2026-06-09): how much active resistance the constraint meets. Near-zero for genuine natural laws; higher for constructs that must be defended. Author honestly; the engine decides certification. Absent values used to default to 0.5, fabricating verdicts.

vindicated_propositions.description: Propositions/doctrines/hypotheses the constraint's operation vindicates (OQ-64 split, 2026-06-05). NOT beneficiaries: a vindicated proposition collects no rents and must never be listed under beneficiaries (beneficiaries are real-world actors only). Compiled to constraint_vindicates/2, which feeds no metric or gate.

omegas.description: Unresolved questions the story leaves open. Strongly encouraged for every story: any constraint whose naturalness, beneficiary structure, or persistence is contestable should carry at least one omega naming the open question.

measurements.description: Time-series observations of the constraint's operation. Strongly encouraged for every story whose constraint has observable drift or enforcement history: aim for 6+ measurements spanning the interval so temporal analysis has data.

coercion_grid.description: OQ-93 leveled coercion grid (ruling (b) 2026-06-10: keep-and-migrate, authored-or-absent). Endpoint snapshots of the four grid metrics at up to four levels: points carry (metric, level, time_point, value) with time_point in {t0, tn}. OPTIONAL and FAIL-CLOSED ABSENT: omitting the block means the gradient/kappa/pattern track reports OPEN for this story — never a default, never 'stable'. Partial grids are legal; sufficiency is decided per-consumer by named-level requirements (consumer-named-levels, operator-CONFIRMED 2026-06-10 — no global fraction threshold). t0/tn are authored here so every point shares them by construction (cannot create OQ-105-style misalignment); the compiler enforces t0 < tn, t0/tn EQUAL to the declared interval's start/end (consumers read at the interval endpoints; a sub-interval grid would be schema-valid but silently unconsumed), every point's time_point in {t0, tn}, and NO duplicate (metric, level, time_point) slot — all fail-loud, not bypassed by --no-validate.
coercion_grid.$comment: FABRICATION BAN (OQ-93 ruling (b), 2026-06-10): the injection/imputation path is KILLED PERMANENTLY — this block is NEVER synthesized from domain priors, category profiles, or scalar metrics; no repair/bridge/imputation clause may manufacture grid points (data_repair.pl and scenario_manager.pl were the named doors; their shim arms are retired with the migration). Authored grid -> compute; absent -> OPEN. A counterfeit gradient feeding a naturalization verdict is the same failure the shim was; first GENERATED grids pass the kappa plausibility gate (operator-ruled 2026-06-11, audits/2026-06-11_oq93_grid_migration/PREREGISTRATION.md) before any consumer reads them.

narrative_context.description: Summary paragraph for Section 1 narrative context

kernel_context.description: Optional. Free-text note naming the contested kernel this constraint is a reading of, which reading it instantiates, and the sibling readings. Parallel to directionality_logic. Absent for ordinary (non-kernel) constraints.

stakeholders.description: Named agents with declared roles from the StakeholderRole dial-set, plus the six-questions interview (the agent surface; the engine computes per-seat classifications). REQUIRED WHENEVER THE CONSTRAINT HAS PARTIES: if base_properties.beneficiaries or victims is non-empty, you MUST author the same agents here (enforced by the stakeholder-coverage rule in allOf). The agents you name in KEY AGENTS / beneficiaries / victims belong here as structured stakeholders. EXEMPT only for a genuine mountain with no beneficiaries/victims (e.g. gravity) — it has no parties to name. AUTHORED-EMPTY RULE (Pattern-5 guard: absence must never satisfy a gate): an explicitly empty array asserts 'no entity's arrangements depend on this constraint' and REQUIRES six_questions.disappearance_verdict = world_unchanged (enforced below) — and is only valid when there are no beneficiaries/victims; omitting the field entirely means 'not authored under the stakeholder surface', a different fact. (History: this layer was loosened to optional during the perspectives-vs-stakeholder A/B perturbation, OQ-83/R4; that 'optional' signal caused weaker generators to drop it even when parties existed — the coverage rule restores the contract without forcing it on gravity.)

gain_flow.description: OQ-92 receipt surface, capture half: who RECEIVES the extraction. Either the literal 'diffuse' (the author AFFIRMATIVELY asserts no seat captures — an authored universal negative, piton-side candidate) or the snake_case name of a stakeholder in stakeholders[] (that seat is the capturer). Tri-valued provenance by construction: named-seat / explicit-'diffuse' / ABSENT (field omitted = not authored under the receipt surface — fail-closed: no capture verdict, no piton refinement, no benignity-gate effect). REFERENTIAL INTEGRITY IS COMPILER-ENFORCED (Draft7 cannot express the cross-field reference): a non-'diffuse' value naming a seat not in stakeholders[] is REJECTED at compile time, fail-loud — runtime absorption to fail-closed is backstop only. FABRICATION BAN (OQ-92 Rulings block, settled by the OQ-90 HALT): this field is NEVER synthesized from metrics; no repair/bridge/imputation clause may infer it (data_repair.pl is the named door). Receipt-of-gain is NOT beneficiary-role: a stakeholder may hold role=beneficiary (benefits-from) without being named here (receives-the-extraction).
gain_flow.$comment: Step-3 build: audits/2026-06-10_oq92_step3_preregistration/PREREGISTRATION.md. Step-2 prototype witness: audits/2026-06-10_gain_flow_prototype/.

fixing_cost.description: OQ-92 receipt surface, cost half: the cost class of fixing/removing this constraint for whoever could fix it, relative to the benefit of fixing. DISTINCT FIELD from gain_flow by ruling (b) — accrual-of-gain and cost-to-fix are independent axes; never merge into one scalar or enum (a merged enum would weld provenance to value). Cell semantics (step-2 prototype, 8/8): 'prohibitive' + gain_flow='diffuse' is the piton cell; 'cheap' + 'diffuse' is transient neglect (NOT piton); a captured constraint (gain_flow names a seat) stays snare-flavored under EITHER cost class — cost never demotes capture. Class atom, not a calibrated scalar (the prototype tested cut-representability, not calibration).

six_questions.description: Story-level answers to the six-questions battery (docs/five_questions.md + R5). Q1 (who benefits/pays) and Q4's seats are carried by the stakeholders[] roles; these fields carry the story-level answers. Placement deviation from MIGRATION_PLAN.md noted: R5 genealogy fields live here (story-level), not per-stakeholder — the founding problem is a property of the constraint, not of a seat.

coordination_function.description: Q3, coordination half: the real coordination problem this arrangement solves, stated without evaluation.

transfer_function.description: Q3, transfer half: what the arrangement moves (money, work, attention, status), from whom to whom.

absent_voices.description: Q4: who would object if they were here, and where are they? Pairs with role=excluded stakeholders. Commentary-grade only (R3): feeds the consensus-provenance check (did unanimity arise because the reading is real, or because dissenting seats were never in the room) — never a classification override.

disappearance_verdict.description: Q5: if this constraint disappeared overnight, does the world rearrange itself or stay roughly the same? world_rearranges = arrangements depend on it (stakeholders exist); world_unchanged = closer to natural fact; contested = the parties dispute which.

disappearance_rationale.description: Q5 supporting text: WHAT would rearrange (or why nothing would).

founding_problem.description: R5 (the sixth question, genealogy/obsolescence): what problem was this arrangement built to solve? Plain statement of the founding problem.
founding_problem.$comment: GATE CLOSED (operator, 2026-06-07): inclusion of the R5 fields was gated on one read — why the pre-existing mandatrophy_resolved wire never fired. Answered against git history same day: the emission was never written in ANY compiler version (engine consumers entered at 6f997d71, hand-authored era; the schema boolean at 3641ae71, JSON-template migration, whose compiler only ever emitted mandatrophy_analysis prose). A dropped seam at the format migration, NOT a gameability wall — R5 inherits no hidden design wall and is the GROUNDING of that dangling intent, not a net-new surface (OQ-83). CONSUMPTION RULE (mismatch-only): this narrative is the most gameable field in the battery — every constraint authors a flattering origin myth. It is NEVER consumed as a claim. The consumer reads only the (founding_problem_status x disappearance_verdict) MISMATCH: status=dead + verdict=world_rearranges => capture/zombie flag, cross-checked against the computed piton/theater path. The flag rewires has_mandatrophy_declaration / is_mandatrophy_resolved; base_properties.mandatrophy_resolved is superseded by this object and remains unconsumed (see CLAUDE.md Critical Distinctions note, retired when the rewire lands).

founding_problem_status.description: R5: is the founding problem still live? live = the problem the arrangement was built for still exists; dead = the problem is gone but the arrangement persists; contested = the parties dispute it.

founding_problem_corroboration.description: R5 provenance (R3-style: corroborated, not self-asserted): WHO attests the founding problem and its status, from what seat? A genealogy answered only by the constraint's own beneficiaries is a cover-story generator — name at least one corroborating source outside the beneficiary set, or state explicitly that none exists (that statement is itself signal).

cs_structure.description: Commitment-system classification. Omit entirely for non-CS constraints.

kernel_codification.description: How the kernel is specified and treated.

authority_grounding.description: What grounds the authority structure's legitimacy.

interpretation_layer_present.description: True = functioning interpretive substructure below the kernel absorbs drift. Valid when authority_grounding ∈ {lineage, extraction, practice} — i.e., an active authoritative interpreter exists (chain of transmission, institutional hierarchy, or community practice). Not valid for distributed/self_enforcing/diffuse_epistemic authority where no designated interpreter exists.

reading_relations.description: Typed edges to sibling readings in the same kernel. Omit for non-kernel constraints.

relation.description: Structural relationship from this reading to the sibling: forecloses=logically rules out sibling in same framework, coexists_with=different parties hold both simultaneously, influences=creates structural pressure without foreclosing

axioms.description: Foundational normative claims this reading holds. Omit for non-kernel constraints.

atom.description: Snake_case identifier for the normative claim (unique across sibling readings)

role.description: foundational=core distinguishing premise of this reading, secondary=implication that follows from the foundational claim

status.description: holdable=live normative claim without internal contradiction, overridden=formally superseded within this reading's own tradition. Do NOT use foreclosed — that is computed by the engine from grounding_type + drift_state.

grounding_type.description: What kind of claim grounds this axiom's legitimacy. empirically_contingent=grounded in testable empirical claims (can be refuted by evidence); deontological=grounded in duties, rights, or intrinsic moral status (not empirically falsifiable); conventional=grounded in social coordination or enacted institutional rule; theological=grounded in religious or divine authority; instrumental=grounded in means-ends efficacy (empirical about efficiency, but normative about goal)

reference_frame.description: t0: snake_case atom naming the reference state this reading takes the kernel to be. NOT a historical date or discovered origin — the committer-axis's declared starting point.

drift_state.description: t1: drift state at a named historical or counterfactual moment relative to t0. Gap(t0,t1) = the drift vector. Omit for non-kernel constraints.

moment.description: Snake_case name for the observation moment (e.g. contemporary, post_empirical_challenge)

direction.description: Direction of drift relative to t0 reference frame

magnitude.description: Size of the gap between t0 and t1

acknowledged.description: Whether the authority structure explicitly recognizes this gap

allOf.$comment: Stakeholder-coverage rule (2026-06-19): a constraint that NAMED parties — non-empty base_properties.beneficiaries or victims — must also author them on the stakeholders[] agent surface (the same agents, with roles + the six-questions interview). A genuine mountain with NO beneficiaries/victims (gravity) is exempt: it has no parties to name. Closes the false-negative class where the weaker generator economized on the prose-required-but-schema-optional field: 423/466 haiku no-stakeholder stories had authored parties (OQ-149; audits/2026-06-18_oq56_twin_within_kernel_perturbation/). The authored-empty case (empty stakeholders + Q5 world_unchanged) is a different fact, governed by the Pattern-5 guard block below and disjoint from this one (a constraint with parties cannot also be authored-empty).

then.$comment: De-leak 2026-06-05: the former extractiveness/suppression maxima were removed so the authored claim and the authored metrics stay independent (the engine computes the type; divergence is the signal). Only the structural requirement remains.

allOf.$comment: FSM candidate: Mountain with declared beneficiaries. false_summit_mountain in signature_detection.pl gates on beneficiary presence alone (coupling is diagnostic only). Require omegas to document the natural-law vs. constructed ambiguity.

CS structure: interpretation_layer_present is only valid when an active authoritative interpreter exists. Valid authority types: lineage (chain of transmission), extraction (institutional hierarchy wielding canonical text or formal rules — fixed_text+extraction is valid; a fixed canonical text wielded for institutional extraction is a standard CS shape), practice (community of practitioners), expertise (credentialed professional body interpreting evidence or standards — e.g., medical guidelines, engineering standards). Excluded: distributed/self_enforcing/diffuse_epistemic (no designated interpreter).

anyOf.$comment: Lineage: interpretation is mediated through a chain of authorized transmitters.
Extraction: an institution extracts benefit from kernel stability; a fixed canonical text wielded for institutional authority is a standard CS shape.
Practice: the practitioner community IS the interpretive body; oral tradition, professional custom, common-law evolution.
Expertise: a credentialed professional body interprets evidence or standards (medical guidelines, engineering standards bodies, peer-review communities).

allOf.$comment: Pattern-5 guard (authored-empty vs absent, OQ-83): an explicitly EMPTY stakeholders array asserts 'nothing is organized around this constraint' — that assertion must be made in the open via the Q5 verdict, not implied by absence. Omitting stakeholders entirely (pre-migration stories) triggers nothing.

OQ-92 receipt surface rides the stakeholder layer: gain_flow is a statement about seats, so authoring it without the stakeholders[] surface is incoherent. Presence of gain_flow requires stakeholders (empty-array case governed by the Pattern-5 guard above).
OQ-92 receipt surface, cost half: same rider — fixing_cost is authored about the same seats (who could fix, at what cost), so it also requires the stakeholders[] surface.

R5 provenance rule (operator ruling, OQ-83): a founding_problem_status may not be authored without the founding_problem narrative AND its corroboration — 'corroborated, not self-asserted' is structural, not advisory. The mismatch consumer reads status x disappearance_verdict only; the narrative is never consumed as a claim.
